extraction_method.parser: Decoded HTML, stripped tags, HTML-unescaped text, normalized whitespace, then inspected manufacturer product title, Product Code, Availability, price and quantity-tier text.
extraction_method.reason: The web browsing tool returned HTTP 502 for the Mesa store; direct HTTPS reads succeeded.
extraction_method.reproduction_python:
import urllib.request, re, html
url = 'https://store.mesanet.com/index.php?route=product/product&product_id=374'
body = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=20).read().decode()
text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>', ' ', body)))
start = text.find('Brand:')
print(text[max(0, start-160):start+550])
